descriptionChirho: The noun mirmas denoting the act of trampling or that which is trampled underfoot. All four clusters represent the same lexical sense with only grammatical variation (construct state, with prepositions le-/b-, with conjunction waw). The multilingual evidence is unanimous: eng 'trampling/a-trampling/trampling-of', spa 'pisoteo/pisoteado', hin 'raunda/raundne-ke-liye' (रौंदा/रौंदने-के-लिए), arb 'dawsan/madrus' (دَوْسًا/مَدْرُوسَ), kor 'balbhim' (밟힘), swa 'kukanyagwa/wakanyagwe'. The slight variation in S114387 toward a passive-participial nuance ('that which was trampled') does not constitute a genuinely distinct sense from the act/result of trampling.
